study_tips.pomodoro: Work 25 min, break 5 min. After 4 cycles, take 15-30 min break.
study_tips.active_recall: Test yourself — don't just re-read. Close the book and recall.
study_tips.interleaving: Mix subjects in one session. Harder but better retention.
study_tips.sleep: 7-9 hours. Sleep consolidates memories. Pulling all-nighters hurts performance.

competition_tips.start_early: Begin preparation 3-6 months before the competition date.
competition_tips.past_papers: Solve past papers under timed conditions. This is the #1 predictor of success.
competition_tips.weak_areas: Focus 70% on weak areas, 30% on maintaining strengths.
competition_tips.mock_exams: Take full-length practice exams to build stamina and time management.
